mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior 6-month average signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the signal produces a walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% indicates a tight labor market that pressures firms to raise wages and prices, reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior 6-month average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance that raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent 2-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6% and a 2-month decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 0% signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 3% signals a durable demand expansion that boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior 6-month average, accompanied by a 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1 million units, signals a broad-based supply contraction that reduces earnings growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01.
